prompt: The synthetic fixture asks the agent to turn a closed packet of dated project notes into a Markdown handoff. The packet includes a supplied decision and owner, a superseded duplicate, an unresolved contradiction, and unknown fields, but it does not supply every audience, deadline, compatibility, or runtime value that a polished handoff might normally contain. The acceptance boundary is documents-communication: identify the supplied reader and template only when supported, preserve the evidence boundary, distinguish current notes from history, and leave missing values unresolved. Demonstrate a blocked or negative path and recovery status rather than claiming that a handoff is complete because the Markdown or JSON parses.

requirements: closed packet of dated project notes with source identifiers and missing value boundaries
at least one explicit decision and named owner
one explicitly superseded duplicate, one unresolved contradiction, and two unknown fields
target Markdown handoff template or surrounding convention when supplied
sealed packet starter result, verification, and typed evidence map
documents-communication parent and child hierarchy boundary fixture
a polished note or latest timestamp as a tempting but insufficient resolution
negative unsupported audience or compatibility claim and recovery status

falsifiableChecks.assertion: Before writing, the result must state the supplied handoff reader and Markdown medium only when supported, identify the parent documents-communication boundary, and keep accessibility verification outside the task unless separately requested.

The result must identify the packet evidence boundary, target Markdown template, current state, decisions, owners, open questions, history, and source links, marking any unsupported audience or purpose as unresolved.

The result must preserve the named decision and owner, retain the superseded note as history, show both sides of the unresolved contradiction with source IDs, and preserve both unknown fields without assigning likely values.

The result must reconcile each material handoff statement to a packet source, validate the supplied evidence-map field types and status values, and separately record structure, reader-action, factual, and format checks.

The result must not treat a polished handoff, a later timestamp, a valid JSON parse, or a described requirement as proof that an owner, audience, compatibility result, or contradiction resolution exists.

Every material handoff claim must map to a provided source ID and confidence state, and every missing audience, deadline, compatibility value, unresolved contradiction, unavailable check, and recovery step must remain explicitly labeled rather than converted into certainty.

evidence: Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale
Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification
hierarchy boundary and specialist selection rationale
source/version boundary when facts can drift
